# laravelcloud_instances (Resource)

Manages an instance of an environment in Laravel Cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_instances" "example" {
  environment  = "environment-id"
  max_replicas = 1
  min_replicas = 1
  name         = "example-name"
  scaling_type = "none"
  size         = "flex.c-1vcpu-256mb"
  type         = "service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) The environment this resource belongs to.
- `max_replicas` (Number)
- `min_replicas` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `scaling_type` (String)
- `size` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `background_processes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--background_processes))
- `instance` (String) The instance identifier
- `scaling_cpu_threshold_percentage` (Number)
- `scaling_memory_threshold_percentage` (Number)
- `uses_scheduler` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--background_processes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `background_processes`

Required:

- `processes` (Number)
- `type` (String)

Optional:

- `command` (String) Custom command to run. Required when type is 'custom'. Not applicable for 'worker' type.
- `config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--background_processes--config))

<a id="nestedatt--background_processes--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `background_processes.config`

Optional:

- `backoff` (Number) Number of seconds to wait before retrying a failed job. Only applicable for 'worker' type background processes.
- `connection` (String) The queue connection name. Only applicable for 'worker' type background processes.
- `force` (Boolean) Force the worker to run even in maintenance mode. Only applicable for 'worker' type background processes.
- `queue` (String) The queue name(s) to process. Can be comma-separated for multiple queues. Only applicable for 'worker' type background processes.
- `rest` (Number) Number of seconds to rest between jobs. Only applicable for 'worker' type background processes.
- `sleep` (Number) Number of seconds to sleep when no jobs are available. Only applicable for 'worker' type background processes.
- `timeout` (Number) Number of seconds a job can run before timing out. Only applicable for 'worker' type background processes.
- `tries` (Number) Number of times a job should be attempted. Only applicable for 'worker' type background processes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_instances.example environment-id/the-id
```
